plain: To grant citizenship to someone born abroad

webster.text: To confer on an alien the rights and privileges of a native subject or citizen; to adopt foreigners into a nation or state, and place them in the condition of natural born subjects.

more.text: To make natural; to render easy and familiar by custom and habit; as, custom naturalizes labor or study.
To adapt; to make suitable; to acclimate; as, to naturalize one to a climate.
To receive or adopt as native, natural or vernacular; to make our own; as, to naturalize foreign words.
To accustom; to habituate; as, to naturalize the vine to a cold climate.

example.quote: power to naturalize, if it had not been expressly given?
